items.caption: An oracle-script form of 果 is drawn as a tree with fruit above it, illustrating the pictographic analysis of the graph.
items.alt: Black stylized tree form with three large, hollow fruit-like shapes above its branches.
items.selection_reason: This identified redraw clearly illustrates the account of 果 as fruit growing on 木.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw in oracle-script style, not an image of an excavated inscription. The specific ancient object and date are not identified.
Early graphic attestations do not establish the word’s meaning in a particular inscription; the earliest securely dated context for 果 meaning fruit remains uncertain.
